canonical_data: ACP session transcripts and tool results, backed by Claude Agent SDK session state on the local host
current_repo_note: Third-party ACP adapter over Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK; the Agent Client Protocol itself is recorded as specification acp, and the SDK as claude-agent-sdk.
strengths: Exposes Claude tool calls, subagents, MCP servers, and terminals to any ACP client
Permission presentation, edit review, and structured session errors and recovery
Versioned npm distribution with a preview channel and changelog
weaknesses: Pre-1.0 protocol surface still evolving through opt-in extensions
Model processing is remote via Anthropic even though the agent runs locally
No adapter-level editable store; coupled to the Claude Agent SDK release line
why_it_matters: The reference open implementation of a provider coding loop behind an open agent protocol, letting any ACP editor drive Claude.
